$comment: What nen EXECUTES in this repository: one gatsby lane at the root. Every verb runs through pnpm scripts so CI and a Hatsu session run the same argv. The policy half is nen/workflow.json.

build.$comment: prebuild collects the pinned source repositories first (scripts/sources/collect.mjs); set BANKAI_SOURCE_<REPO> or run pnpm sources:fetch

test.$comment: vitest: names-map completeness, codename redaction, config, components. The slow build lane is `pnpm test:build`.

coverage.$comment: vitest --coverage (v8); lcov.info is the report nen parses, json-summary beside it

ui-test.$comment: Playwright smoke with axe at 390px and 1440px against gatsby serve; needs `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` once

archive.unsupported: A static site has no archive step: the build output under public/ is the artifact the host deploys from.

deploy.unsupported: The host for bankai.zheref.dev is TBD by the maintainer; declare a target here once it is chosen.

release.unsupported: No release lane yet: the site deploys from main once a host is chosen; tags are optional.

node.why: Gatsby 5 supports Node 18+; the CI workflow pins 20

gatsby.why: Install locked dependencies with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first: every verb on this lane is a pnpm script. The source repositories the build reads are fetched by `prebuild` (scripts/sources/collect.mjs) at the commits sources.json pins when absent.
